advisory.askTitle: Ask {assistant} to suggest an index or rewrite

emptyBody: A monitor is a set of live SQL widgets, polled on an interval and plotted over time.
monitorEmptyBody: Add a widget: a SQL query polled every few seconds and plotted. A trend samples a number over time; a snapshot re-runs a query and replaces the chart.

qp.selectToAnalyze: Select a connection in the sidebar to analyze
qp.title: Query Performance

subtitle.time: heaviest statements by total time, point-in-time
subtitle.read: heaviest statements by data read, point-in-time
subtitle.memory: heaviest statements by peak memory, point-in-time

qp.selectDatabase: Select a database in the connections sidebar, connect it, then click "Collect data" to see its heaviest queries.
qp.noStatsLong: {name} exposes no runtime query statistics, so there is no workload to analyze.
qp.connectSidebar: Connect "{name}" in the sidebar to collect its heaviest queries.
qp.clickCollect: Click "Collect data" above to load {name}'s heaviest queries.
qp.noStatements: No statements recorded yet. Run some queries against this database, then collect again.
qp.hintMysqlDenied: This needs SELECT on performance_schema. Ask a DBA to grant it (e.g. GRANT SELECT ON performance_schema.* TO your_user), then collect again.
qp.hintMysqlMissing: performance_schema appears to be disabled on this server. Enable it (performance_schema=ON) to see the workload.
qp.hintPgMissing: This needs the pg_stat_statements extension. Run CREATE EXTENSION pg_stat_statements (and add it to shared_preload_libraries + restart), then collect again.
qp.hintDenied: Reading this database's query statistics needs extra privileges (e.g. VIEW SERVER STATE on SQL Server, SELECT ANY DICTIONARY on Oracle, or MONITOR on Snowflake). Grant access, then collect again.
